marta: heads up — after yesterday's kernel-change deploy I'm seeing a small but consistent tail-latency regression on short prompts (<= 64 tokens). KV hit rate dropped ~6% in the last 3 hours. anyone seen this?
aj: saw it in the profiler too. decode-rate buckets shifted — more requests ended up in the slow decode bucket during batching. attaching short trace: ```
batch_id=42 decode_rate=0.8->1.4 tokens/s kernel=fast_attn fallback=false
latency_p95=240ms -> 360ms
kv_hits=0.87 -> 0.81
```
kevin: thanks. quick hypothesis: the new kernel selection favors `fast_attn` for mid-length sequences but its memory access pattern is hurting KV prefetch heuristics. when that happens batching holds onto more contexts waiting for prefetched KV and increases queueing.
ciara: can we try lowering the kernel selection threshold from 0.6 -> 0.45 for mid sequence-length cohort and run microbench? command i used locally: `./tools/bench --model=redwood-7b --seq=64 --rate=300 --cohort=short`
aj: also tweak token-budget target for the short-prompt cohort from 1024 -> 768; that reduces max batch size and seems to avoid aggressive kernel handoff in my sim.
perf-bot: alert at 2026-03-17T10:11:03Z — rolling 15m p95 latency up 45ms, kv_hit_rate drop 5.9%. Related deploy: ops/2026-03-16-kernel-selection-v2.
marta: good notes. plan: 1) ciara run bench with kernel-threshold=0.45 and token-budget=768 on staging; 2) aj will push a canary rollout to 10% traffic with kernel fallback enabled; 3) kevin to prepare quick rollback patch if perf doesn't improve. can we aim to have results in 2 hours? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
aj: running now, will post raw numbers to this thread.
kevin: i'll also add a tiny change to KV prefetch timing (+8ms) to test whether prefetch alignment helps without changing kernel heuristics.
ciara: test started — baseline -> canary in progress. logs are sparse but i'll paste the micro results when done.
marta: thanks y'all. if the canary looks good we'll merge to main and include a note in deploys channel. :thumbsup:
